description: Utility helper functions for extracting and formatting 'credits' data from API responses, handling different casing conventions and nested structures.

methods.name: getCreditsUsed(details)
methods.description: Safely extracts the 'credits used' value from API response details, handling camelCase, snake_case, and nested data structures. Returns null if the value is missing or not a finite number.

methods.name: formatCredits(value, locale = undefined)
methods.description: Formats a numeric credits value into a locale-aware, fixed-precision string, using up to 4 decimal places or no decimal places if the value is an integer. Returns '—' if input is null or undefined.
